description: Lake at rest with wetting and drying and the default WENO reconstruction (A 514 4): a 2-cell wide creek with 5 cm of water between dry banks 2.5 m above the water (T 10 boxes, A 544 0.01), connected to the deep part. The velocities stay exactly zero; before the WENO face states of eta took the eta of the dry banks into their stencil (0.33 m/s after 100 s, 2.5 m/s in the Tagus estuary at rest).
covers: nhflow_reconstruct_weno::wetdry_x, wetdry_y, slope_wd (eta next to dry cells)
